data.title: MosaicML
data.content: MosaicML can be used to fine-tune their own open source foundation models such as MPT-30B. According to Mosaic, 'you own your model entirely, including the model weights'. They publish frequently to their user base and their suite of tools are interoperable both internally and with other models.

data.title: DraGAN
data.content: Drag Your GAN is an AI tool developed for controlling generative adversarial networks with increased flexibility, precision, and generality. The tool allows users to synthesize visual content by manipulating the pose, shape, expression, and layout of generated objects through the interactive point-based manipulation on the generative image manifold. It is composed of feature-based motion supervision that drives handle points to target positions and a new point tracking approach that leverages GAN features to localize the position of handle points. The code for DragGAN is open source and available on HuggingFace, built on existing open source architectures including StyleGAN3. It forms part of a broader generative workflow for producing and manipulating visual content. The code related to the DragGAN algorithm is licensed under CC-BY-NC. However, most of this project are available under a separate license terms: all codes used or modified from StyleGAN3 is under the Nvidia Source Code License.

data.title: KoboldAI
data.content: KoboldAI is 'a browser-based front-end for AI-assisted writing with multiple local and remote AI models' featuring an 'Adventure mode' for playing games like AI Dungeon Unleashed. Interoperable with multiple LLMs and writing/gameplay formats, this tool has broad scope for creative narrative building within differing technical framworks. Can be played online for free via Colab.

data.title: StableVicuna-13B
data.content: Open source LLM from StabilityAI with high level of transparency, though access to LLaMA is required to run it. Training process is published alongside datasets and model code. Its HuggingFace page is currently paused.

data.title: Never Before Heard Sounds
data.content: Browser-based tool for extracting and recombining sonic features. Limited information available so far, but potentially significant for a range of sonic / multimedia practices. Collaborated with Holly Herndon on her 'digital twin' Holly+.
